gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-adlam-un: Chunky, confident strokes with wide-open bowls: that's College, with every curve as stout as its stems. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined sits below at a modest size, its capitals hardly taller than the lowercase and its curves leaving generous gaps.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-anatolia: College draws every line as if with a stylus held at constant pressure, so its curves are as heavy as its stems. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs follows in a tall x-height and outward-pointing tips, easy going on the eye.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Noto Sans Arabic brings wide openings and a pronounced x-height to the body, with a friendly, uncluttered look. And College above it joins its strokes without any thinning or bulging, a blunt, solid counterpart.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Noto Sans Armenian stands its c, s and z tall and full, with round letters that open wide and invite you in. Shrink College too far and its tubelike lines lose their punch.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Noto Sans Avestan keeps the tips of its curves from touching and carries a pronounced x-height. And College, cut like sign-shop vinyl at a single line width, gives it a bold header to sit under.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-balinese: College has zero modulation in its line, no thick and no thin, and big counters in a tall lowercase that give it authority. Noto Sans Balinese brings breathing room inside its curves and short ascenders.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-bamum: College has no hairlines and no swells anywhere. Make it small and that heft gets lost, whereas Noto Sans Bamum with its big open counters in every small letter holds up fine even when the size grows.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-bassa-va: Noto Sans Bassa Vah has a huge midsection and an open-jawed c like pliers. College above it draws a steady, marker-like line, so a body size slightly under the heading's would keep the two from crowding.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-batak: College lays its strokes down like fine rope, every curve as thick as a stem, with big counters in a tall lowercase. Noto Sans Batak towers in x-height like a stubby carpenter's pencil, its wide-open e never squeezed.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Noto Sans Bengali keeps its capitals barely taller than lowercase, with distinctly open letter mouths. Noto Sans Bengali gives way to College's heavier look, whose w has no thick or thin strokes, for a bold lead.
